layout.arrangement: Two large rectangular panels stacked vertically within a main red border. Top panel titled 'Initialized weights'. Bottom panel titled 'Updated weights (after iteration # 10)'. Slide number '33' in a yellow circle at top-right.

regions.name: Top Panel
regions.position: top, left to right, approx 45% height
regions.content: Neural network diagram showing initialized weights. Input layer (x1, x2, Bias), Hidden layer (3, 4, 5), Output layer (6, 7), Target matrix.

regions.name: Bottom Panel
regions.position: bottom, left to right, approx 45% height
regions.content: Neural network diagram showing updated weights after iteration #10. Same structure as top panel with different weight values and output values.

layout.hierarchy: The two neural network diagrams are the dominant visual elements. Red headers distinguish the panels. Text is black sans-serif. Node circles are yellow/orange.

visual_elements.description: Top neural network diagram. Input layer: node x1 (value 1), node x2 (value 5), Bias node (value 1, blue circle labeled 1). Hidden layer: nodes 3, 4, 5 (yellow circles) with outputs O3, O4, O5. Output layer: nodes 6, 7 (orange circles) with outputs O6, O7. Connection weights labeled on lines. Right side: Target box with matrix values 0.791, 0.791 in col 1 and 0, 1 in col 2. Labels t6, t7 on far right. Footer: η = 5 in red.

Bottom neural network diagram. Same structure. Input layer: x1 (1), x2 (5), Bias (1). Hidden layer: 3, 4, 5. Output layer: 6, 7. Connection weights updated (e.g., 0.155, 0.675, -0.999, etc.). Right side: Target box with matrix values 0.064, 0.939 in col 1 and 0, 1 in col 2. Labels t6, t7. Footer: η = 5 in red.

typography_notes: Sans-serif font throughout. Headers ('Initialized weights', 'Updated weights...') are red and bold. Node labels inside circles are black. Weight labels are small black or colored text. Subscripts used for variables like x₁, O₃.
recreation_brief:
1. Create a slide with light gray background (#E8E8E8).
2. Add a large red-bordered rectangle covering most of the slide.
3. Add slide number '33' in a yellow circle at the top-right corner.
4. Create Top Panel: Header 'Initialized weights' in red bold text at top-left of panel.
5. Draw Neural Network: Input nodes x1(1), x2(5), Bias(1-blue). Hidden nodes 3, 4, 5 (yellow circles). Output nodes 6, 7 (orange circles).
6. Add connection weights for top panel: x1->3(0.1), x1->4(0.2), x1->5(0.4); x2->3(0.3), x2->4(0.5), x2->5(0.6); Bias->3(0.1), Bias->4(0.1), Bias->5(0.1); 3->6(0.3), 3->7(0.3); 4->6(0.4), 4->7(0.4); 5->6(0.5), 5->7(0.5); Bias->6(0.2), Bias->7(0.2).
7. Add Target box on right of top panel: Matrix [[0.791, 0], [0.791, 1]]. Labels t6, t7.
8. Add 'η = 5' in red at bottom-right of top panel.
9. Create Bottom Panel: Header 'Updated weights (after iteration # 10)' in red bold text.
10. Draw same Neural Network structure.
11. Add connection weights for bottom panel: x1->3(0.155), x1->4(0.215), x1->5(0.305); x2->3(0.675), x2->4(0.575), x2->5(0.625); Bias->3(0.115), Bias->4(0.115), Bias->5(0.105); 3->6(-0.999), 3->7(-0.835); 4->6(-0.93), 4->7(-0.943); 5->6(-0.856), 5->7(-1.2); Bias->6(1.05), Bias->7(-0.77).
12. Add Target box on right of bottom panel: Matrix [[0.064, 0], [0.939, 1]]. Labels t6, t7.
13. Add 'η = 5' in red at bottom-right of bottom panel.
